StorageTools.Title: Mass storage
StorageTools.Description: The device's volumes in a file browser, and copies to and from them — every copy read back from the media and checked by SHA-256.
StorageTools.Note.NoDisk: Windows has not made a disk of this function yet.
StorageTools.Note.NoVolume: The disk has no volume Windows could mount — no media, or a file system Windows does not read.
StorageTools.Column.Name: Name
StorageTools.Notice.NoViewer: Nothing in Nexaflow opens {0}. Copy it to the PC to open it in another program.
StorageTools.Confirm.Title: Copy onto the device
StorageTools.Confirm.Message: Copy {0} into {1}? Each file is read back from the device and checked against the original. Anything there with the same name is kept, and the copy named alongside it.
StorageTools.NewFolder.Title: New folder
StorageTools.NewFolder.Label: Name
StorageTools.Rename.Title: Rename
StorageTools.Rename.Label: New name
StorageTools.Delete.Title: Delete from the device
StorageTools.Delete.Message: Delete {0} from {1}? A USB drive has no Recycle Bin, so this cannot be undone.
StorageTools.Result.Failed: {0} failed — the Diagnostics tab lists them.
StorageTools.Result.BadName: “{0}” cannot be a file or folder name.
StorageTools.Result.ClipboardBusy: Another program is using the clipboard — try again.
